findings.summary: Path containment check uses startswith(base) without a path separator, so a member like ../out_evil/x resolving to a sibling directory such as /cache/out_evil/x passes and is written outside the output directory.
The rar helper has the same startswith-without-separator containment check, allowing sibling-directory path traversal.
The 7z helper has the same startswith-without-separator containment check, allowing sibling-directory path traversal (the existing tar helper has it too).

SevenZipExtractor.extract passes a possibly empty filtered targets list to archive.extract; depending on py7zr version an empty list may mean no filter and extract everything, including blocked members.
The badlink helper in the 7z safemembers is defined but never used, so link checking is not applied.
